answer: Work waits on the delta until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the violet of the next round. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the knoll of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, revoked by a single upheld challenge, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
